Weekday USFSP Ride (St. Petersburg Bicycle Club)

St. Petersburg, FL · Downtown · Road

Weekday USFSP Ride (St. Petersburg Bicycle Club) is a road group ride in St. Petersburg, FL. It rolls mondays and Tuesdays and Wednesdays and Thursdays and Fridays at 8:00 am from USFSP campus, 2nd St S and 6th Ave S, green concrete balls in front of the bronze bull. About 17 miles, monday, Wednesday, Friday 20 mph controlled; Tuesday and Thursday 17-19 mph on the first loop.

For visitors

Show and go, no sign-up. Up to 50 riders on a given day. The club's Facebook group has the latest updates.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Weekday USFSP Ride (St. Petersburg Bicycle Club) group ride

The St. Pete club's daily weekday road loop: 4th St S to Pinellas Point Drive, north through Lakewood, and home on 6th Street, with three optional sprint points. Some days a second, faster partial loop follows.
